caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical composition dominated by botanical motifs. In the center, there is a stylized tree or plant with a curved, arching trunk and two large, feathered branches that extend outward and downward, each tipped with what appear to be red berries or small fruits. The trunk is flanked by two green foliate garlands, each decorated with alternating red, circular rose-like flowers and dark green leaves. The background within the central rectangle is muted green, while around this core image, a wide beige border is filled with repeated clusters of green leaves and red flowers or berries, arranged in horizontal and vertical bands along the edges. The corners of the border are marked by bunches of berries tied with bows and tassels. The main colors in the drawing are muted green, beige, red, and dark green, with black line details accentuating the shapes and contours of the leaves and flowers. The composition is organized in a rectangular frame with an emphasis on repeating botanical and decorative elements.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
